columns.definition: Provide a text description of the product. This information will appear in paragraph form on the detail page of your product. Include unique product features, product line details, and product specifications. Do not use all caps.

columns.label: Bullet Point
columns.definition: Brief descriptive text, called out via a bullet point, regarding a specific aspect of the product. These display directly under or next to your product photo, it is useful to put interesting information in these fields. Do NOT use all caps or abbreviations. Please do NOT use for fabric content, care instructions or country as these are populated in different fields.

columns.label: Generic Keyword

columns.definition: Provide any terms that may be relevant to customer searches. No repetition, no competitor brand names or ASINs.

columns.label: Unit Count
columns.definition: For products that are consumed by volume, weight, linear dimension, etc., provide the net quantity that would be shipped to a customer who orders one ASIN (e.g. 12 pack of 6 floz. bottles of water = 72, vs. a single 2 liter bottle = 2). For products consumed as individual units, provide the total number of units (pack of 12 pens = 12). For packed assortments of non-identical items, enter 1

columns.label: Unit Count Type
columns.definition: For items consumed by volume, weight, linear dimension etc., provide the unit of measure listed on the products. For products consumed as individual units, enter: count

columns.label: Product Site Launch Date
columns.definition: Provide the date the product launches and should first be shown on the Amazon website (YYYY-MM-DD format). PSLD does not impact buyability or pre-order logic, it is used to indicate when a product will be visible and searchable on the Amazon website

columns.label: Included Components

columns.label: League Name

columns.label: Team Name

columns.label: Control Method

columns.label: Compatible Device Size Maximum
columns.definition: Please enter in the maximum size of device that the product has the capacity to hold or protect for example a 15 inch laptop.

columns.label: Device Size Compatibility Unit
columns.definition: Provide the corresponding unit used to designate the maximum device size the cover can accommodate.

columns.label: Number of Packs
columns.definition: Provide the count of inner packs included in an item. For a single pack or packed assortment of non-identical items, enter 1.

columns.label: Compatible Headphone Models
columns.definition: Provide the headphone models the item is compatible with. Headphone models are often composed of a brand, and an alphanumeric name.

columns.label: Compatible Tablet Computer Models

columns.label: Compatible Amazon Tablet Models

columns.label: Compatible Notebook Computer Models

columns.label: Set Name
columns.row6_example: Strata Ultimate Golf Club Set (16 Piece)
columns.definition: Provide the manufacturer's official name for the product set. If no official name exists, summarize the type and number of its components.

columns.label: Hardware Color
columns.definition: Provide the color of metal parts on the item, such as knobs, clips, hooks, or zippers, which are used for function and style.

columns.label: Government Contract Name
columns.definition: Enter the name of your active government contract (e.g., NASA SEWP V). This helps surface your offers to government customers

columns.label: Government Contract Number
columns.definition: Enter your active Government contract number (e.g., 47QTCA19D000C). This ensures products are recognized for federal procurement.

columns.label: Item Weight Unit
columns.definition: Provide the unit of measurement for the item weight of the portable electronic device cover, such as a unit for measuring mass.

columns.label: Skip Offer
columns.definition: Please indicate whether the offer should be skipped and a buyable offer should not be created. A value of "Yes", means no offer will be created.

columns.label: Item Condition

columns.label: Offer Condition Note

columns.label: List Price
columns.definition: Provide the list price for the product not including tax. List Price is the suggested retail price of a product as provided by a manufacturer, supplier, or seller. This is not the offering or cost price. If you are unable to provide a value, enter 0.

columns.label: Product Tax Code

columns.definition: Enter the quantity of the item you are making available for sale. This is your current inventory commitment (as a whole number)

columns.label: Handling Time (US)
columns.definition: Provide the time, in days, between when you receive an order for an item and when you can ship the item

columns.label: Restock Date (US)
columns.definition: Provide the date that product will be restocked using YYYY-MM-DD format

columns.label: Inventory Always Available (US)
columns.definition: Always available inventory is an alternative to quantity that allows inventory to never deplete. Enabling or disabling will toggle this feature on or off. Note that a quantity cannot be specified when provided.

columns.label: Sale End Date (Sell on Amazon, US)
columns.definition: The last date that the sale price will override the item's standard price (YYYY-MM-DD format); the product's standard price will be displayed after 0:00AM of Sale End Date. (Sell on Amazon)

columns.label: Offering Release Date (Sell on Amazon, US)
columns.definition: Provide your price start date using YYYY-MM-DD format (Sell on Amazon)

columns.label: Stop Selling Date (Sell on Amazon, US)
columns.definition: Provide your price end date using YYYY-MM-DD format (Sell on Amazon)

columns.definition: Provide the number of layers of master packs held on a pallet packed for storage (known as Hi).

columns.label: Master Packs Per Layer Quantity
columns.definition: Provide the number of master packs of the product in each layer on a pallet (known as Ti).

columns.label: Country of Origin
columns.definition: Select the product's country of origin

columns.label: Warranty Description
columns.definition: Provide a description of the product's warranty

columns.label: Are batteries required?
columns.definition: Select "yes" if batteries are required to power the item (or if the item is a battery) or "no" if they are not. Please note that an internal rechargeable battery is also considered a battery

columns.label: Are batteries included?
columns.definition: Select "yes" if batteries are contained in the product (e.g. batteries inside a pair of Bluetooth headphones) and/or included with the product (e.g. batteries packed separately with a camera), otherwise select "no"

columns.label: Battery Cell Composition
columns.definition: Select the chemical composition of the battery cell

columns.label: Battery Cell Composition Other Than Listed
columns.definition: Provide the components of the item's battery cell that are not already listed under battery cell composition.

columns.label: Battery IEC Code
columns.definition: Provide the item’s battery IEC code. IEC is standardized alphanumeric nomenclature based on battery size & type available on battery itself.

columns.label: Battery Weight
columns.definition: Provide the total net weight (numeric value) of the batteries included. This is the weight of the standalone batteries not including packaging or the device it may be used in.

columns.label: Battery Weight Unit
columns.definition: Provide unit for battery weight

columns.label: Number of Batteries
columns.definition: Specify the number of batteries needed to power the item.  If batteries are included with the item be sure to account for spare batteries provided

columns.label: Battery Type
columns.definition: Provide battery type needed to power the item, including spares if included. Some options may be moved under other attribute eg. IEC code

columns.label: Number of Lithium Metal Cells
columns.definition: Specify the total number of Lithium Metal cells in the product where the cell isn't contained in an encased battery (e.g. coin cells)

columns.label: Number of Lithium-ion Cells
columns.definition: Specify the total number of Lithium-ion cells in the product where the cell isn't contained in an encased battery. For example, an AA battery is considered a cell

columns.label: Lithium Battery Energy Content
columns.definition: Provide the total energy stored in the lithium batteries used to power the item, measured in Watt Hours.

columns.label: Lithium Battery Energy Content Unit
columns.definition: Select the corresponding unit

columns.label: Lithium Battery Packaging
columns.row6_example: Batteries contained in equipment, Batteries packed with equipment, Batteries only
columns.definition: Select “in equipment” if the battery is contained in the item . Select “with equipment” if the battery is packed separately with the device it is meant to power. Select “only” if the product is a battery sold alone or with items it is not meant to power.

columns.label: Lithium Battery Weight
columns.definition: Provide the weight of lithium contained in the cell or battery as a numeric value

columns.label: Lithium Battery Weight Unit
columns.definition: Select the corresponding weight unit

columns.label: Dangerous Goods Regulations
columns.definition: Provide the regulations that apply to the item if it is classified as a dangerous good, hazardous material, substance, or waste.

columns.label: GHS Class
columns.definition: Select the GHS Class of the product from the list of valid values if GHS is selected as the Dangerous Goods Regulation. GHS Class indicates the warning statement assigned by the GHS classification system.

columns.label: Hazmat Aspect
columns.definition: Select the aspect or regulatory body used for the hazardous product information

columns.label: Hazmat
columns.definition: Provide hazmat information that is relevant to the product based on the aspect selected

columns.label: Safety Data Sheet (SDS or MSDS) URL
columns.definition: Provide the web address for the Safety Data Sheet, containing essential safety information for potentially hazardous materials.

columns.label: Is This Product Subject To Buyer Age Restrictions
columns.definition: Provide whether the product is subject to buyer age restrictions. These can influence the purchase and/or delivery of the product.

columns.label: California Proposition 65 Warning Type
columns.definition: Select the warning type applicable to your product, if any. You certify that the warning provided satisfies legal requirements and that you’ll remove a warning previously provided only if it is no longer legally required.

columns.label: California Proposition 65 Chemical Name(s)
columns.definition: If you selected the Food, Furniture, or Chemical warning you must indicate a chemical(s). You certify that the chemical(s) satisfies legal requirements and that you’ll remove a chemical previously provided only if it is no longer legally required.

columns.label: Includes Rechargeable Battery
columns.definition: Indicate whether the product includes rechargable batteries

columns.label: Pesticide Marking
columns.definition: Provide any pesticide marking on the item or packaging.

columns.row6_example: Product is not a pesticide or pesticide device, as defined under the U.S. Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act.

columns.label: FCC ID
columns.definition: If the device has an FCC ID, provide it.

columns.label: SDoC Contact Name
columns.definition: If the device has a Supplier's Declaration of Conformity, provide the name of the point of contact for the Responsible Party, as defined by the FCC.

columns.label: SDoC Contact US Mailing Address
columns.definition: If the device has a Supplier's Declaration of Conformity, provide a US mailing address for the Responsible Party, as defined by the FCC.

columns.label: SDoC Contact Email Address
columns.definition: If the device has an SDoC, provide an e-mail address (in this field) or a US phone number (in the next field) for the Responsible Party, as defined by the FCC. If you provide a phone number in the next field, you may enter "N/A" in this field.

columns.label: SDOC Contact US Phone Number
columns.definition: If the device has an SDoC, provide a US phone number (in this field) or an e-mail address (in the prior field) for the Responsible Party, as defined by the FCC. If you provide an e-mail address in the prior field, you may enter "N/A" in this field.

columns.label: Safety Attestation
columns.definition: Check “yes” if your product doesn’t have any warning and safety information, as it can be used safely and as intended without it.

columns.label: Manufacturer’s Email or Electronic Address
columns.definition: Provide the email or URL of the manufacturer. If you've submitted this information for the brand before, use the same email or URL.

columns.label: Has Multiple Battery Powered Components
columns.definition: Provide whether the item consits of more than one battery powered components.

columns.label: Ships Globally
columns.definition: Provide whether the item can be shipped globally by Amazon

columns.label: Contains Battery or Cell
columns.definition: Provide whether the item uses cells with a single electrochemical unit or batteries with multiple connected cells within a casing.

columns.label: Battery Contains free Unabsorbed Liquid
columns.definition: Provides certification that your battery meets transport regulations for free-flowing liquid: no unabsorbed liquid at 55°C & no leakage.

columns.label: Is Battery Non Spillable
columns.definition: Provides certification confirming your battery meets transport regulations for non-spillable status, including vibration and pressure tests

columns.label: Non-Lithium Battery Packaging
columns.definition: Provide "in equipment" for batteries installed in devices, "with equipment" for those packed separately with the device, and "only" for standalone batteries.

columns.label: Has Replaceable Battery
columns.definition: Provide whether the item's battery is replaceable.

columns.label: Non-Lithium Battery Energy Content
columns.definition: Provide the item's energy content for non-lithium batteries. The attribute refers to the total amount of energy that a battery can store.

columns.label: Non-Lithium Battery Energy Content Unit
columns.definition: Provide unit of measure used to determine the total amount of energy that a battery can store.

columns.label: Has Less than 30 Percent State of Charge
columns.definition: Provide whether the item's battery contains less than 30 percent charge during shipping.

columns.label: Battery Installation Device Type
columns.definition: Provide the item's battery installation type. Specifying whether a battery is installed in a vehicle, vessel, or not installed in any device.

columns.label: Is OEM Sourced Product
columns.definition: Provide whether the item is directly sourced from the original equipment manufacturer (OEM).

columns.label: GHS Chemical H Code
columns.definition: Provide the GHS chemical hazard codes for the chemical substance/mixture in order to display warnings to customers.

columns.label: BAA/TAA Regulation Compliance
columns.definition: Select BAA compliant (refer FAR 52.225-2); BAA compliant due to exception (refer FAR 25.103); TAA compliant (refer FAR 52.225-6)

columns.label: BAA TAA Compliance Acknowledgement
columns.definition: You acknowledge you are authorized to certify products as BAA/TAA compliant and will immediately update BAA/TAA status change to Amazon.

columns.label: TAA Compliant Country
columns.definition: Select the TAA country where products are manufactured or substantially transformed.
